label: AI Step Stream
description: ONE AI STEP, A DIFFERENT OUTPUT FOR EVERY PERSON: lead cards (photo, name, company, what they did) stream in from the left and pass into a single flow step drawn in the product's card look (default 'AI Email', 'Written for each person'); the step glows and a sheen crosses it while it thinks; out the right comes that person's own email -- To, subject, first line. The first `slow` go one at a time, slow enough to read, then the gaps shrink to `fast_gap` and it becomes a stream (cycling the leads). The AI beat of an automation film: a template sends everyone the same thing, this step writes for each person. Give every lead a subject and a line that could only be theirs. Full frame; 1440-wide design stage at the box's aspect, scaled to the box.

leads.label: The people, in order (the stream cycles them)

photo.label: Photo URL (a face in the circle)

did.label: What they did (the lead card's coloured line)

line.label: Their email's first line, only theirs

subtitle.label: Step subtitle (default 'Written for each person'; '' for none)

slow.label: How many go one at a time before the stream (default 3)

until.label: Stream stops starting new leads at (s, default the scene end)

lead_accent.label: The lead cards' 'what they did' colour (default the accent)

still.label: The step is there from the first frame
